subject.title: feat: optionally show runtime status after /new and /reset

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support automatic runtime details after `/new` and `/reset` through a new `commands.showRuntimeStatusOnReset` configuration key, rather than relying on the existing `/status` inspection command?
rationale: The patch is bounded and default-off, but accepting it creates a public configuration and documentation contract for a convenience behavior that overlaps an existing supported command.

options.title: Keep runtime inspection explicit
options.body: Decline the new setting and retain compact reset acknowledgements, with `/status` remaining the supported way to inspect the active runtime.

options.title: Adopt the opt-in setting
options.body: Accept the new default-off command contract and retain the cross-path tests so chat and Gateway acknowledgements continue to agree.

recommendation.title: Keep runtime inspection explicit
recommendation.body: Decline the new setting and retain compact reset acknowledgements, with `/status` remaining the supported way to inspect the active runtime.
